consent.title: Privacy and Demo Consent
consent.description: What we ask, what we do with it, and what we never do.
consent.whatWeAskDesc: Basic household facts like age, district, education, occupation, and approximate income range.
consent.whatWeDoDesc: We evaluate official criteria deterministically right inside your browser to match government schemes.
consent.whatWeNeverDoDesc: We never ask for OTPs, passwords, Aadhaar numbers, or bank credentials. No data leaves your device.
consent.howToClearDesc: You can start over and clear demo data anytime with one tap.
consent.localProcessingDesc: All profile answers and scheme rules are evaluated entirely inside your browser. No personal data is uploaded to cloud servers.
consent.noCredentialsDesc: We never collect OTPs, passwords, bank credentials, or real Aadhaar cards.
consent.checkboxLabel: I understand that this is guidance and not an official decision, and I agree to proceed.
consent.readAloudUnsupported: Read-aloud is not supported on this browser.
